title: Open a mimi-protocol issue: From vs From-Host for the source provider (-07 §4.1 note)
description: Promised to Jason: open an issue on github.com/ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-protocol for the editor's note in -07 §4.1 ('The use of the From header field here is not really well-aligned with its intended use ... Perhaps something like From-Host'), kept separate from #218/#219. Point out that with provider-auth signatures the field becomes security-relevant, so it should be decided in the same round as #219, and that whatever is chosen must be covered by the signature. Mark has not taken a position on From vs From-Host; ask before arguing for either. Use the threaded-reply/announce conventions; link the issue from the provider-auth Open Issues. Source: Jason Bolduc's review on mimi@ietf.org, 15 Nov 2026 (Message-ID CA+7d1z=LQ+iuYYum-z-SUssV8X5PJgeZL7EW5R2f0Jd4FkzTvA@mail.gmail.com); Mark committed to it publicly in his reply of 16 Nov (IETF notes/2026-11-16-mimi-provider-auth-jason-reply-sent.md). Draft source: ~/PROJECT/ietf-mimi-provider-auth/draft-atwood-mimi-provider-auth.md.
acceptance_criteria: Issue filed on mimi-protocol (number recorded in notes); linked from provider-auth -01 Open Issues.
